sites.functional_impact_measured: GloSensor luminescence cAMP assay: agonist-stimulated (isoprenaline and salbutamol) concentration-response curves recorded in the clonal TS-SNAP-β2AR cell line, confirming preserved Gs-coupled signalling. L5 additionally reports constitutive Gs signalling with FLAG+HiBiT-tagged β2AR; L6–L9 confirm surface display by live-cell M1 anti-FLAG labelling in non-permeabilised cells.
sites.rationale: ADRB2 (UniProt P07550) carries no signal peptide; residues 1–33 form the sole extracellular N-terminal domain (TM1 begins at residue 34, giving 33 residues of clearance). Because there is exactly one extracellular terminus, every ledger line reporting an 'N-terminal' tag on the full-length receptor maps unambiguously to a prepend before M1 (insert_after_residue = 0, residue_after = M). No ledger line names a specific residue, so position_evidence is topology_derived. The N-terminal prepend does not disturb N6, N15, or N187 glycosylation sites, nor any disulfide cysteine (none in residues 1–33), and multiple independent studies confirm surface expression and full agonist-stimulated cAMP signalling. Clonal HEK293G cells stably overexpressing full-length human β2AR bearing an N-terminal Twin-Strep affinity tag plus SNAP-tag (TS-SNAP-β2AR); receptor is membrane-anchored and expressed at the cell surface. Corroborated by at least seven additional ledger lines (L1, L2, L3, L5, L6–L9, L12, L14, L15) all reporting N-terminal FLAG, HA, HiBiT, or SNAP tags on full-length membrane-anchored β2AR. [validation: surface_and_function; position: topology_derived; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: Figure 2 shows the time courses of GloSensor TM luminescence responses stimulated by increasing concentrations of isoprenaline (Fig. 2a ) and salbutamol (Fig. 2b ) in a clonal HEK293G cell line overexpressing the human β 2 -adrenoceptor containing an N-terminal Twin-Strep affinity purification tag and an N-terminal SNAP-tag (TS-SNAP-β 2 AR 37 ).

literature_notes: L10 and L11 report a C-terminal GFP fusion of mouse β2AR; the C-terminus falls in the intracellular region (residues 328–413, topology INTRACELLULAR) and therefore does not qualify as an extracellular site. L15 also lists a C-terminal Venus fusion (B2AR-Venus) which is likewise intracellular and was excluded. No ledger line reports a tag insertion in any extracellular loop (ECL1 96–107, ECL2 172–197, ECL3 296–306) of β2AR or a close ortholog, so no internal loop sites are proposed. All qualifying lines (L1–L9, L12–L15) converge on the same N-terminal prepend position, which is reported as a single site with the strongest functional evidence (L13) as the primary citation.
